title: Convert a length to a float string
description: Write a function `length_as_string(word)` that returns `len(word)` first converted to a float, then to a string.
hints: Functions to consider: len(), float(), str()
Each conversion is a separate step: len() gives an int, float() turns that int into a float, and str() turns that float into text - the three calls chain together, innermost first.
expected_behavior: Returns the word's length as a float, then as a string.
explanation: Chaining conversions (str(float(len(word)))) reads inside-out, the same as any nested function call - len() runs first, then float() on its result, then str() on that.
